lines.text: In a village surrounded by endless forests,
there was a house that nobody had entered for fifty years.
Every night, a light appeared in its upstairs window.
The strange part was that the house had no electricity,
and no connection to the outside world.
One day, a young explorer decided to enter it.
Inside, everything was covered in dust,
except for a single photograph lying on a table.
It showed the explorer standing in front of the same house.
But the photograph was dated fifty years ago.
